answer: Rewards vest slowly: each agent payout sits in escrow for thirty days, and any peer can bridge evidence of a duplicate identity to an auditor during that window. If the claim holds, the whole escrow of every linked clone is clawed back and burned. A Sybil farm at the zenith of its output then has the most money frozen and exposed, so faking identities turns earnings into umber ash rather than profit; the attacker pays in locked capital and delay.
